item.title: Editorial: RFK Jr.’s vaccine skepticism is entering a new phase
item.description: The stability of the U.S. vaccine market rests on an obscure $4 billion fund known as the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., long a critic of the fund, now appears intent on dismantling it.
